text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...It's starting, isn't it?

"Admire Vega mutters softly beside me. 
...Immediately after, a deafening roar of 
cheers engulfs the surroundings."
(Waaaaaaaaahhhhh!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now, leading the field is this 
Umamusume, number 7, T.M. Opera O! With 
overwhelming support, she is the proud 
number one favorite!

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
"We did hear reports that she got a bump 
on her head just a moment ago, but that 
shouldn't be an issue. Her talent and 
foundation are rock solid!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...No, what are you doing?

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"And the Umamusume you can't mention T.M. 
Opera O without! Gate 13, Meisho Doto! 
Second favorite—can she finally seize her 
long-sought victory this time?!"

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
She's been rapidly improving her skills, 
after all. Can she finally hand the 
Supreme Overlord a defeat this time? Keep 
your eyes glued to this one!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...Since they're saying all that about 
you, you should hold your head a little 
higher."

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And—the moment you fans have all been 
waiting for! Here comes our Umamusume!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
—I look forward to working with you! I'm 
Narita Top Road!

text_block_list.name: Top Road Fans
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaahhh!!)

text_block_list.name: Top Road Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaaagh, Top Road-san, Top 
Road-saaaan...!!

text_block_list.name: Top Road Fan B
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*, *hic*...! Congratulations on 
entering the Arima Kinen! I truly, totally 
believe you're gonna wiiiin--!!

text_block_list.name: Top Road Fans
text_block_list.text: (UWAAAAAAAARGGGHHH--!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
L-Listen to this cheering!! Gate number 4, 
Narita Top Road, the 3rd favorite!!

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
Though she missed out on running in the 
Japan Cup... Her undying spirit of 
challenge just makes you want to root for 
her. I have high hopes for her too!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Shall we head over to the grandstands?

And so, when it came time to run in the 
Arima Kinen—

Slipping past relentless marking in the 
crowded pack, TM Opera O surged from 11th 
place on the final straight to snatch 1st 
place by a nose.

Her fated rival, Meisho Doto, finished in 
2nd place. The crowd went wild at the 
Opera O's tenacious, fierce run—
Narita Top Road finished in 9th place.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: —I have lost!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I know, because I was watching.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Um, I'm sorry for being such a 
disgrace.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I'm only midway through crawling 
my way back up, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you how desperately I can 
struggle. I'll struggle and struggle, and 
keep struggling more stubbornly than 
anyone else!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Until the day I face you, Opera O-chan, 
and Doto-chan head-on and win!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"I will absolutely live up to 
expectations!" Because that's... who 
Narita Top Road is!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Then I can still afford to be a little 
selfish, can't I?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Claw your way back up. ...And make sure 
you live up to my expectations.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha! ――Yes!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen concludes— The year turns, 
and the seasons cycle anew.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh? A-Ah, y-yes... Umm, Opera O-san...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Still, our era is far from over.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-san, me, Doto. And Top Road-san.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Isn't that right?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: —Yes.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Let us race. Again and again, let us 
compete. Together, we shall play an 
endless quartet—!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Launching the glory carved by the four 
stars, even into the high-noon sky.
